brief: Coffee futures closed at 278¢/lb — down 5.6% on the week and down 22.2% on the month. The regime model reads the market as crisis and has for 6 sessions. Rainfall in the Central Highlands is running above its seasonal norm (+1.3σ) — favorable moisture for the robusta belt. The crop is in its fruit filling window, and stage-weighted stress is low. The Brazilian real is little changed on the month (+0.8%) — a neutral currency backdrop. Looking ahead: the 14-day forecast calls for 82 mm of rain in the robusta belt against a 132 mm seasonal norm (-0.8σ) — projected crop stress: low (Open-Meteo forecast model, issued 2026-09-25; skill scored publicly as windows close).
